snippet.title: Odin’s Fate | Reveal Trailer | Norse Mythology Tower Defense
snippet.description:
Odin’s Fate is a story-driven Tower Defense game set in Norse mythology. You play as Odin, who can manipulate time during battle and tries to rewrite the fate the Norns have woven.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955760/Odins_Fate/
Discord: https://discord.gg/stVyJ9DgfU

The story takes you from Ymir through Loki’s schemes and Thor’s adventures to Ragnarök. We based it on medieval sources and modern translations of the myths. In battle, you’re supported by a team of three heroes, including Thor, Loki, Heimdall and Ivaldi. You can upgrade your towers and combine their elements into synergies, and there are difficulty modifiers for players who want a real challenge.

We’re a small four-person studio located in the Poland with a deep love for Norse mythology. If you like what you see, please add Odin’s Fate to your wishlist on Steam. It’s the best way to support us.

--------------------

We appreciate your support on the Patreon:
https://patreon.com/TaleForge
